title: Fix CI: CRM example validation errors and CLI lint error
body:
CI on main is broken due to two issues: `@objectstack/spec@3.0.4` now enforces `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$` on explicit select option values, and an ESLint `ban-ts-comment` error in the CLI package.

- **CRM example**: Stage field used explicit `{ value: "Closed Won", ... }` object syntax — unlike string shorthand which auto-lowercases, explicit values must be valid identifiers. Changed to snake_case (`closed_won`, `closed_lost`, etc.) while preserving labels.
- **CLI lint**: `@ts-ignore` → `@ts-expect-error` in `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`

```ts
// Before — fails spec validation
{ value: "Closed Won", label: "Closed Won", color: "green" }

// After
{ value: "closed_won", label: "Closed Won", color: "green" }
```
